limitations: Only neutral closed-shell singlets with H/C/N/O are admitted by this profile.
The engine must reject a molecule with more than 80 atomic orbitals before the SCF kernel call.
The minimum-distance check is an engineering refusal and does not validate or optimize chemical geometry.
Every coordinate must have absolute value at most 10000 angstrom; this is an engineering input bound, and coordinates are never recentered automatically.
No coordinates, atom order, hydrogen count, charge or spin are modified automatically.
RHF convergence does not establish wavefunction stability, experimental accuracy or a global energy minimum.
This profile does not run conditional-state calculations, geometry optimization or automatic method fallback.
